name: Electrical Charge, Lesser
body:
School evocation [electricity]; Level bloodrager 1, magus 1, sorcerer/wizard 1, witch 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (1 piece of copper)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 5 rounds + 1 round/level (max 5)
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You charge the target’s body with electricity, dealing 1 electricity damage to them at the beginning of their turn. A successful Fortitude save negates the damage for the round. This spell counters a spell of equal or lower level and is countered by a spell of equal or higher level from the vitriol group of spells. If the target is affected by an earth or acid descriptor spell of the same spell level or higher, this spell ends.
